text_block_list.text:
On New Year's Day, Chrono Genesis invited 
me to visit the shrine where Tracen 
Academy students traditionally go for 
Hatsumode.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A-As my goal for this year... I have 
pledged to achieve back-to-back Grand
Prix 
victories...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A-And also... rather than just running... 
I-I want to hype things up even more than 
in usual years...
choice_data_list: When you say "hype it up"...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A-And if possible... I would love for as 
many people as possible to participate in 
the fan vote...!
choice_data_list: When you say "hype things up"...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Prix is a race made by the fans 
and Umamusume together. I want so many 
people... to know that fun and joy...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I want you to experience... the same 
thrill that moved me so deeply...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: However, in order to do that—

text_block_list.text:
The year-end Arima Kinen was so hyped!
The 
first back-to-back Grand Prix victories
by 
a Tiara Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Race Cafe Customer B
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, with Almond Eye and all, it 
really is the era of strong Tiara 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.text:
Well, I didn't vote, so I guess I wasn't 
really paying much attention.

Ever since online voting became
available, 
the number of votes has increased quite a 
bit, but...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"If possible... I want this vote to be 
something that lets us share deep
emotions 
with the Umamusume..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
As a fan...
I want them to enjoy the Grand 
Prix just as much as I used to get
excited 
for it...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Because... Japan is the only place where 
fan voting decides who gets to run.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
S-Some say the flourishing state of 
Japanese Umamusume racing... is largely 
thanks to the power of the fans...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
In Australia, they even created a race 
with fan-voted entry slots modeled after 
the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Still... the fan-voted entry slots come 
with various operational challenges, and 
the future outlook seems uncertain, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Japanese Umamusume racing...
has long been 
supported and sustained by its fans...

So that's why you're a symbol of J...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... That is another reason why, even 
among the classic path... I chose the 
Grand Prix.

So that's why they're an icon of J...

text_block_list.text:
I see, a choice true to Chrono Genesis, 
who deeply values racing history.

To encourage votes for the Grand Prix... 
what kind of appeal should we present?

Whether it's a race or a festival, it's 
always far more enjoyable to participate 
than to merely watch.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's right.
The Grand Prix holds a 
lot of participatory events,
including the 
fan voting...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
For the Arima Kinen, they even set up 
event booths all over town...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Casual fans too...
An event makes it much 
easier for everyone to join in...!"

"Casting your own vote makes a dream 
showdown come to life. There's really 
nothing more enticing than that, is 
there?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-Indeed... Perhaps its true charm hasn't 
been conveyed well enough...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Those who have an Umamusume they truly 
care about...
are the very ones who should 
cast their votes, after all...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Appealing to people's 'fandom culture' 
side... is definitely worth 
considering...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It seems official channels are already 
utilizing social media for promotion, 
but... if we were to take it even further—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Do you mean... making waves that make 
people want to talk about them...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Loves-chan seems like she'd know a
lot 
about this sort of thing. I'll go ask 
her...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much... I will take your 
feedback to heart...!

"Knowing more about Umamusume allows you 
to enjoy the races on a deeper level. If

that—"

Optimistically...!
